messages:
Priya Rao: Support reported ProdRollout-42 rollback after an autofallback. They said the console only showed 'fallback: on' and no reason.
Lee Kim: We need a proper inspector panel, not just a flag. Operators need trigger type + metric deltas.
Jon Patel: Suggestion: show 'signal contribution' stacked bar (RATE / ERR_5XX / GPU_UTIL / QUEUE). Each slice includes value + threshold.
Aisha Varma: Add fallback_confidence (0-100). If <30 label 'likely transient'. Helps triage noisy spikes.
Priya Rao: How do we compute contribution? Be explicit. Backend should return per-rule match output: rule_id, match_value, threshold, contribution_pct.
Lee Kim: Decision payload sketch from engine: policy_id, ts, action, variant, fallback_confidence, signals[], trace_id, rollout_id. UI uses that to render inspector.
Jon Patel: Permissions: sampled payloads and trace links only for authorized roles. If redacted show 'sample truncated'.
ops-bot: [system] autofallback.decision rollout=ProdRollout-42 variant=gpt-eco-v1 reason=RATE_LIMIT confidence=78 trace=tr_9b2c5d
Priya Rao: Request dry-run mode in console: simulate fallback and collect inspector data without changing traffic. Tag events dry_run=true and store for review.
Aisha Varma: Dry-run should still create non-actionable audit events so teams can test safely.
Lee Kim: Add TTL and hysteresis controls: default TTL=60s, backoff multiplier=2, max=5m. Show current TTL in inspector and allow temporary override (must include audit note).
Jon Patel: Telemetry labels to add: fallback.policy_id, fallback.decision_ts, fallback.variant, fallback.confidence, fallback.signals (encoded), fallback.ttl_ms, fallback.mode.
Priya Rao: Add 'why-not-earlier' comparator showing 5m of signal timeline before decision.
Aisha Varma: Include suggested actions list (increase quota, enable batching) with links; advisory only. Also surface basic quality regression score for dry-runs (embedding-sim delta).
Lee Kim: Correlate fallback events with alert IDs and tag rollout_id + model_version.
Priya Rao: Action items: Jon = telemetry + decision payload, Lee = TTL/hysteresis controls, Aisha = mock inspector UI, Priya = update runbook.
